# Holi Typst

Holi Typst is a local-first Typst editor focused on writing, preview, export,
and future encrypted collaboration. The current editor does not require an
account or upload document contents to Holi.

## URL

- https://typst.holi.tools/

## Capabilities

- Edit Typst documents in the browser.
- Persist work locally.
- Preview/render through browser-side tooling.
- Export document artifacts.

## Implementation Parameters

- App package: `holi-typst`
- App path: `web/apps/typst`
- Product brief: `web/apps/typst/product.md`
- Roadmap: `docs/roadmap.md`
- Collaboration decision: `docs/decisions/0002-private-collaboration.md`

## Privacy Notes

- No account is required for the current core workflow.
- Documents are processed and persisted on the device by default.
- Cloudflare can process IP address, request time, routing data, and traffic
  volume when it serves application resources.
- Collaboration is planned, not enabled in the current release, and must use
  explicit sharing plus application-layer end-to-end encryption.
